Fixed journal bug where every journal showed the same text
Fixed sound effect issue that the monster was too quiet

notes.title: Update Version 1.4.8
notes.content:
[olist]
The settings have been fixed. Now when you change the settings, it will stay the same in every scene and will remain the same even after the game closes, so you won't have to change them every time you reload the game. 
[/olist]
